description: This Java class implements the DeleteAttributeStrategy, which handles the DeleteAttribute command in a persistence context for 'things'. It manages attribute deletion, constructs result objects, and handles entity tags.

classes.name: DeleteAttributeStrategy
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy to handle DeleteAttribute commands, performing attribute deletion and generating corresponding events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete attribute command, verifies attribute existence, and returns success or error result.

methods.name: getDeleteAttributeResult
methods.description: Constructs the result after successful attribute deletion, including event creation.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag for the attribute being deleted, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no next entity tag after deletion.
